# codigate_identity_provider (Data Source)

Looks up an identity provider by id or by name, for example one made in the dashboard. The client secret is never returned.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# An identity provider made in the dashboard, used by an app managed in Terraform.
data "codigate_identity_provider" "entra" {
  name = "Microsoft Entra ID"
}

output "entra_redirect_uri" {
  value = data.codigate_identity_provider.entra.redirect_uri
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Identity provider id (idp_...). Set id or name.
- `name` (String) Identity provider name. Must match exactly one identity provider.

### Read-Only

- `client_id` (String) OIDC client id (null for email).
- `groups_claim` (String) ID token claim with the user's groups (null for email).
- `has_client_secret` (Boolean) Whether a client secret is stored.
- `issuer` (String) OIDC issuer URL (null for email).
- `redirect_uri` (String) Redirect URI to register at the OIDC provider (null for email).
- `scopes` (List of String) Extra scopes requested besides openid, email and profile.
- `type` (String) oidc or email.
